summary: Bounded transactional outbox service-loop lifecycle seam over the Tokio poller runtime.
claim_boundary: Lifecycle seam only. This slice adds bounded service-loop config/report types and a loop that runs Tokio poller epochs over injected async runner, sleeper, and shutdown-signal traits. It does not install an OS daemon, signal handler, process supervisor, live SQLx pool, live broker/gRPC client, deployment, or delivery guarantee.

facets.F1_simplicity: The service loop layers max-epoch, epoch-pause, shutdown checks, and aggregate reporting over the existing Tokio poller function instead of duplicating poller tick/backoff policy.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: The seam prepares future horizontally scaled outbox worker processes by bounding epoch loops, surfacing shutdown stop reasons, and keeping runner/sleeper/shutdown dependencies injectable.
facets.F3_adversarial: Tests cover invalid service config, shutdown before first epoch, max-epoch completion with one inter-epoch pause, and shutdown after a completed epoch without an extra pause.
facets.F4_api_contract: The public surface adds AsyncOutboxShutdownSignal, NeverStopOutboxShutdownSignal, OutboxPollerServiceConfig, OutboxPollerServiceStopReason, OutboxPollerEpochReport, OutboxPollerServiceReport, and run_tokio_outbox_service_loop.
facets.F5_quality: Focused runtime tests plus the 41-package backbone check/test/clippy/fmt matrix, cargo-deny, license-policy, cargo-prefix, catalog/data-class known-blocker probes, parse/config validation, dependency-seam, honest-claims, and diff hygiene are part of this run.
facets.F6_operations: Reports expose service stop reason, per-epoch poller reports, total ticks, and aggregate claimed/published/dead-letter/error counts for future daemon health and telemetry binding.
facets.F7_security_privacy: The service loop adds only operational counters and stop reasons; it carries no payload bodies, raw message/mail/post content, database URLs, broker URLs, credentials, or principal secrets.
facets.F8_supply_chain: No new third-party dependency is introduced; the change remains isolated inside the existing Tokio runtime app crate already allowed by dependency-rationales.
facets.F9_testing: Focused tests passed for 8 runtime crate tests and the broad backbone matrix passed 258 unit tests plus the existing ignored metrics adapter doctest.
facets.F10_ci_cd: The crate is already present in GitHub Actions and all four Jenkins package matrices; this slice preserves that matrix coverage without claiming remote CI execution.
facets.F11_observability: The service report aggregates per-epoch poller reports into lifecycle-level counts that can later bind to canonical runtime metrics and health endpoints.
facets.F13_reversibility: The slice is isolated to one existing runtime app crate plus catalog/task/evidence documentation; removing it does not affect pure outbox policy, worker-cycle, SQLx drain, or dispatch crates.
